reflection_R1.decision_rule: pure deterministic candidate (sigma<2): PSNR on all k pairs; CHANGE only if >40 dB or +2 dB vs previous round
reflection_R1.rationale: The sev4->5 hypothesis is well motivated by signal reinterpretation, but the mandated cross-support PSNR validation rejects it: candidate mean 25.19 dB vs control 26.05 dB (delta -0.86 dB < +2 dB), no draw >40 dB, and per-pair deltas change sign (+8.68/-12.74/+1.49). x_distortion blur_motion draws angle U(-90,90) per apply, giving a 20.2-32.3 dB spread for the same pipeline - larger than the sev4/sev5 effect - so single-draw PSNR cannot arbitrate severity. Evidence insufficient -> keep R0 pipeline item-for-item.
